comparison.objective: Tune and lock damping versus capture and transfer an angle with a bevel gauge, then draw a guided line.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve fine rotational adjustment and retention; candidate locks a collar and tests impacts, while the record adjusts a passive hinge, preserves its angle during transport, and guides marking.
comparison.success_condition: Dynamic stop quality and setting retention versus reference-face fit, angle preservation, line coverage/accuracy, and limited stray ink.
comparison.reason: Fine rotation is shared, but the tested physical ability and downstream validation are materially different. Candidate final tolerances remain undeclared.
